export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/gmr-aero-academy (and slug variant gmr-aero-academy-private-limited, and gmr-airports-limited) returned only the generic template line: "Shipments available for GMR AERO ACADEMY, refreshed daily" — zero actual shipment rows rendered (0 rows seen out of an unstated counter; the page exposes no numeric shipment count). No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was visible on any page.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrievable: web_search backend was down ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused") for every query, and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403 while importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge page. Zero domestic supply records seen.
note: No shipment evidence could be verified either way — this is a tooling/access failure, not a finding of absence. ImportKey pages for this name are JavaScript shells that render no rows; all four permitted second sources (volza, eximpedia, importgenius, trademo) were blocked (403 / JS challenge). Therefore export_status and domestic_status are recorded as unknown, NOT as none_found, and no HS code, date, destination or B/L number is asserted. Substantive point for the file: the claimed legal entity 'GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED' is an airport operator/holding company, while 'GMR Aero Academy' is a DGCA-type aviation training organisation — a training school does not itself ship aircraft (HS 8802) or parts (HS 8805/8807); any HS 880211/880529 trade would sit with the parent or an MRO affiliate, so the declared HS codes are unverified against this name. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in any source reached). Recommend re-run when the search backend is restored and a paid/authenticated customs view is available.
